# DATA PREPARATION


## STEP 1: Setup and Load R Packages


```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = F,
                      message = F,
                      tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=80), 
                      tidy=TRUE)

options(scipen=999)

library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(haven, psych, foreign, tidyverse, coefficientalpha, 
               magrittr, dplyr, panelr, lme4, lmerTest, performance,
               misty, ggplot2, jtools, HLMdiag, lmtest, reghelper, 
               emmeans, pvaluefunctions, knitr, formatR, simr,sjPlot)
```

```{r ethnicity, echo=FALSE}
results <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = character(),
  Euro = integer(),
  Maori = integer(),
  Pacific = integer(),
  Asian = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ethnicities <- c("Euro", "Maori", "Pacific", "Asian")
timepoints <- sprintf("T%02d", 1:14)

for (timepoint in timepoints) {
  counts <- c(Timepoint = timepoint)
  for (ethnicity in ethnicities) {
    col_name <- paste0("EthL2.", ethnicity, ".", timepoint)
    if (col_name %in% names(dataset)) {
      if (timepoint == "T01" && ethnicity == "Euro") {
        counts[ethnicity] <- sum(dataset[[col_name]] == "NZ European", na.rm = TRUE)
      } else if (as.numeric(sub("T", "", timepoint)) <= 12) {
        counts[ethnicity] <- sum(dataset[[col_name]] == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        counts[ethnicity] <- sum(dataset[[col_name]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    } else {
      counts[ethnicity] <- 0
    }
  }
  results <- rbind(results, as.data.frame(t(counts), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

knitr::kable(results,
             caption = "Ethnicity")
```


# MAIN ANALYSIS AND RESULTS


## STEP 0: Granger Causality Test Without Considering Multilevel Data Structure


```{r granger, echo=FALSE}
ds_long$SDO_std <- scale(ds_long$SDO, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_long$SYSJ_std <- scale(ds_long$SYSJ, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_long$EQU_std <- scale(ds_long$EQU, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

granger_df <- ds_long %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Correlation = cor(SDO_std, SYSJ_std, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    EQU = first(EQU_std)
  )

grangertest(Correlation ~ EQU, order = 2, data = granger_df)
grangertest(EQU ~ Correlation, order = 2, data = granger_df)
```


```{r granger female, echo=FALSE}
ds_female$SDO_std <- scale(ds_female$SDO, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_female$SYSJ_std <- scale(ds_female$SYSJ, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_female$EQU_std <- scale(ds_female$EQU, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

granger_df_female <- ds_female %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Correlation = cor(SDO_std, SYSJ_std, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    EQU = first(EQU_std)
  )

grangertest(Correlation ~ EQU, order = 2, data = granger_df_female)
grangertest(EQU ~ Correlation, order = 2, data = granger_df_female)
```


```{r grangerplot female, echo=FALSE, fig.cap = "Mean Levels of X (Structural Gender Equality) and Y (Correlation between SDO and System Justification) across Time", fig.show='hold', out.width = "60%"}
legend_pos <- "top"

ggplot(granger_df_female, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Correlation, color = "Correlation SDO and System Justification"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EQU, color = "Gender Equality Index"), size = 1) +
  labs(
    y = "Mean-Centered Coefficient", x = "Year",
    color = "Legend"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2009:2022) +
  theme_apa(legend.pos = all_of(legend_pos)) +
  scale_colour_grey() +
  theme(
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black")
  )
```


```{r granger male, echo=FALSE}
ds_male$SDO_std <- scale(ds_male$SDO, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_male$SYSJ_std <- scale(ds_male$SYSJ, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
ds_male$EQU_std <- scale(ds_male$EQU, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

granger_df_male <- ds_male %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Correlation = cor(SDO_std, SYSJ_std, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    EQU = first(EQU_std)
  )

grangertest(Correlation ~ EQU, order = 2, data = granger_df_male)
grangertest(EQU ~ Correlation, order = 2, data = granger_df_male)
```


## STEP 1: Fit the Baseline Model


```{r baseline, echo=FALSE}
baseline <- lmer(SYSJ ~ 1 + (1 | id), data = ds_long, REML = FALSE)
summary(baseline)

confint(baseline, method = "Wald")
```


```{r baseline female, echo=FALSE}
baseline_female <- lmer(SYSJ ~ 1 + (1 | id), data = ds_female, REML = FALSE)
summary(baseline_female)

confint(baseline_female, method = "Wald")
```


```{r baseline male, echo=FALSE}
baseline_male <- lmer(SYSJ ~ 1 + (1 | id), data = ds_male, REML = FALSE)
summary(baseline_male)

confint(baseline_male, method = "Wald")
```


## STEP 3: Centering of Predictors


```{r centering}
# Grand mean centering

## Gender Equality Index
ds_long <- ds_long %>%
  mutate(EQU_gmc = EQU - mean(EQU, na.rm = TRUE))

## SDO
ds_long <- ds_long %>%
  mutate(SDO_gmc = SDO - mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

# Centering within clusters (ID)
ds_long <- ds_long %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_SDO = mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDO_cwc = SDO - mean_SDO
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Grand mean centering of the aggregated variable (mean_SDO)
ds_long <- ds_long %>%
  mutate(mean_SDO_gmc = mean_SDO - mean(mean_SDO, na.rm = TRUE))
```


```{r centering female}
# Grand mean centering

## Gender Equality Index
ds_female <- ds_female %>%
  mutate(EQU_gmc = EQU - mean(EQU, na.rm = TRUE))

## SDO
ds_female <- ds_female %>%
  mutate(SDO_gmc = SDO - mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

# Centering within clusters (ID)
ds_female <- ds_female %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_SDO = mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDO_cwc = SDO - mean_SDO
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Grand mean centering of the aggregated variable (mean_SDO)
ds_female <- ds_female %>%
  mutate(mean_SDO_gmc = mean_SDO - mean(mean_SDO, na.rm = TRUE))
```


```{r centering male}
# Grand mean centering

## Gender Equality Index
ds_male <- ds_male %>%
  mutate(EQU_gmc = EQU - mean(EQU, na.rm = TRUE))

## SDO
ds_male <- ds_male %>%
  mutate(SDO_gmc = SDO - mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

# Centering within clusters (ID)
ds_male <- ds_male %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_SDO = mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDO_cwc = SDO - mean_SDO
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Grand mean centering of the aggregated variable (mean_SDO)
ds_male <- ds_male %>%
  mutate(mean_SDO_gmc = mean_SDO - mean(mean_SDO, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## STEP 5: Add SDO as Predictor


```{r mod2, echo=FALSE}

## STEP 6: Add Random Slope for ID


```{r mod3, echo=FALSE}
mod3 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc + SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id), 
             data = ds_long, REML = FALSE,
             control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
summary(mod3)

confint(mod3, method = "Wald")
```


```{r mod3 female, echo=FALSE}
mod3_female <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc + SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id), 
             data = ds_female, REML = FALSE,

```{r mod3 male, echo=FALSE}

## STEP 7: Add Interaction between SDO and EQU


```{r mod4, echo=FALSE}
mod4 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc * SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id),
  data = ds_long, REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(mod4)

confint(mod4, method = "Wald")
```


```{r mod4 female, echo=FALSE}
mod4_female <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc * SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id),
  data = ds_female, REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(mod4_female)

confint(mod4_female, method = "Wald")
```


```{r mod4 male, echo=FALSE}
mod4_male <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc * SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id),
  data = ds_male, REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)
summary(mod4_male)

confint(mod4_male, method = "Wald")
```


```{r plotmod4 female, echo=FALSE, fig.cap = "Fitted Interaction Model Predicting System Justification", fig.show='hold', out.width = "60%"}
plot <- graph_model(mod4_female,
  y = SYSJ, x = SDO_cwc, lines = EQU_gmc, errorbars = "CI",
  labels = list(
    y = "System Justification",
    x = "SDO",
    lines = "Gender Equality Index"
  )
)

plot <- plot + scale_color_manual(
  values = c("-1 SD" = "black", "+1 SD" = "grey")
)
plot <- plot + theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

print(plot)
```


### Decompose Interaction Effect


```{r decomposed female, echo=FALSE}
equ_minus <- mean(ds_female$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(ds_female$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)
equ_mean <- mean(ds_female$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)
equ_plus <- mean(ds_female$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(ds_female$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)

mylist <- list(EQU_gmc = c(equ_minus, equ_mean, equ_plus))
emtrends(mod4_female, ~EQU_gmc, var = "SDO_cwc", at = mylist)
```


# ADDITIONAL ANALYSES: SUBGROUP COMPARISON


## STEP 1: Majoritized Women (NZ European Heterosexual Women)


```{r majority, echo=FALSE}
ds_female$Euro.Ever.L <- ifelse(ds_female$Euro.Ever.L == "Yes", 1, 0)
ds_female <- ds_female %>%
  rename(EUR = Euro.Ever.L)

EUR_women <- subset(ds_female, EUR == 1 & SexualOr == "Heterosexual")

EUR_women <- EUR_women %>%
  mutate(EQU_gmc = EQU - mean(EQU, na.rm = TRUE))

EUR_women <- EUR_women %>%
  mutate(SDO_gmc = SDO - mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

EUR_women <- EUR_women %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_SDO = mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDO_cwc = SDO - mean_SDO
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

EUR_women <- EUR_women %>%
  mutate(mean_SDO_gmc = mean_SDO - mean(mean_SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

EURmod0 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc + SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id), data = EUR_women, REML = FALSE)

EURmod1 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc * SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id),
  data = EUR_women, REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

anova(EURmod0, EURmod1)
summary(EURmod1)

confint(EURmod1, method = "Wald")
```


```{r plotmajority, echo=FALSE, fig.cap = "Fitted Interaction Model Predicting System Justification (Majoritized Women)", fig.show='hold', out.width = "60%"}
plot_majority <- graph_model(EURmod1,
  y = SYSJ, x = SDO_cwc, lines = EQU_gmc, errorbars = "CI",
  labels = list(
    y = "System Justification",
    x = "SDO",
    lines = "Gender Equality Index"
  )
)

plot_majority <- plot_majority + scale_color_manual(
  values = c("-1 SD" = "black", "+1 SD" = "grey")
)
plot_majority <- plot_majority + theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

print(plot_majority)
```


### Decompose Interaction Effect


```{r decomposed majority, echo=FALSE}
equ_minus1 <- mean(EUR_women$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(EUR_women$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)
equ_mean1 <- mean(EUR_women$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)
equ_plus1 <- mean(EUR_women$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(EUR_women$EQU_gmc, na.rm = TRUE)

mylist1 <- list(EQU_gmc = c(equ_minus1, equ_mean1, equ_plus1))
emtrends(EURmod1, ~EQU_gmc, var = "SDO_cwc", at = mylist1)
```


## STEP 2: Minoritized Women (NZ Ethnic Minority Women)


```{r minority, echo=FALSE}
ETHMIN_women <- subset(ds_female, EUR == 0)

ETHMIN_women <- ETHMIN_women %>%
  mutate(EQU_gmc = EQU - mean(EQU, na.rm = TRUE))

ETHMIN_women <- ETHMIN_women %>%
  mutate(SDO_gmc = SDO - mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

ETHMIN_women <- ETHMIN_women %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_SDO = mean(SDO, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDO_cwc = SDO - mean_SDO
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ETHMIN_women <- ETHMIN_women %>%
  mutate(mean_SDO_gmc = mean_SDO - mean(mean_SDO, na.rm = TRUE))

ETHMINmod0 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc + SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id), data = ETHMIN_women, REML = FALSE)

ETHMINmod1 <- lmer(SYSJ ~ EQU_gmc * SDO_cwc + mean_SDO_gmc + (1 + SDO_cwc | id),
  data = ETHMIN_women, REML = FALSE,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

anova(ETHMINmod0, ETHMINmod1)

summary(ETHMINmod1)

confint(ETHMINmod1, method = "Wald")
```


```{r plotminority, echo=FALSE, fig.cap = "Fitted Interaction Model Predicting System Justification (Minoritized Women)", fig.show='hold', out.width = "60%"}
plot_minority <- graph_model(ETHMINmod1,
  y = SYSJ, x = SDO_cwc, lines = EQU_gmc, errorbars = "CI",
  labels = list(
    y = "System Justification",
    x = "SDO",
    lines = "Gender Equality Index"
  )
)

plot_minority <- plot_minority + scale_color_manual(
  values = c("-1 SD" = "black", "+1 SD" = "grey")
)
plot_minority <- plot_minority + theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

print(plot_minority)
```
